description: Adversarial/harder supplementary set spanning both test_papers/ PDFs, built specifically to differentiate retrieval methods (the original tests/golden/qa_set.json was curated to only include questions that already worked with cosine, so it can't show accuracy differences between methods). Includes cases verified to genuinely MISS with plain MiniLM+cosine as of this benchmark run.

cases.question: What value of epsilon was used in the Adam algorithm?
What warmup schedule was used for the learning rate?
What dropout probability Pdrop was used for the base model?
What is the wavelength range used in the positional encoding?
What dataset was used for the English to German translation task?
What regularization technique is used besides dropout?
